metadata.description: Review a change or an area of code for exploitable security weaknesses at its trust boundaries (input handling and injection, authentication and authorization, permissions, secrets, signatures and crypto, and risky execution paths such as shell, file system, deserialization, and outbound requests) and report evidence-backed findings with location, exploit path, impact, severity, and remediation, or state plainly that nothing exploitable was found. Use when the user asks for a security review or audit, a threat or vulnerability check, or whether code can be exploited or abused. Not for a general review of a diff for defects (reviewing-changes) or for explaining security concepts.
